title: eriogonum ursinum var. covillei
intro: Eriogonum ursinum var. covillei, commonly known as Bear's Cliff Buckwheat, is a perennial plant species in the buckwheat family. It is a shrub-like plant that is native to the western United States, and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The plant has been reported to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Eriogonum ursinum var. covillei include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which may contribute to its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
